title: Poor quality.
text:
Poor quality.. I bought these to bottle kombucha. The cap mechanism is so cheap and loose, it will not seal. Don't buy if you want a bottle that wont leak.
Update: I doubled up the red seal and that seemed to fix the leaking problem. Still, I can only use half of the bottles using this fix...

product_metadata.title: Estilo Swing Top Clear Glass Bottles,16oz Set of 6 Easy Cap Clear Bottles with Stoppers, Flip Top Glass Bottles to Store Home Brews, Oils, Vinaigrettes, Wines, Beer, Teas, Limoncello
features: High-Quality Glass Bottles - Value Pack Set of 6 refillable swing-top glass bottles constructed from durable, thick glass. Perfect for storing your oils, vinaigrettes, syrups, wines, teas, limoncello and more!

Leakproof and Airtight Cap - Keep contents inside fresh with the built in, resealable cap. The metal clamp with durable plastic & silicone stopper makes for a leak-proof and secure seal. Stopper opens and closes with ease.
Environmentally Friendly - Cut down on your use of plastic by using these reusable glass bottles that are dishwasher safe.
Versatile Bottle - Not only are these bottles suitable for holding liquids, they can also be used as great table & home décor or a gift for someone's birthday, Thanksgiving, Christmas, etc.
High-Quality - These multi-use bottles are crafted of heavy-duty, sturdy, transparent glass. Each bottles holds 16oz and measure 10 inches tall and 2.5 inches at the base.
description: Bottle you favorite home brews, vinaigrette, wines, beer, teas, and more, with ease. Value set of six 16 oz. clear swing-top glass bottles with unique "leak proof" metal clamp and silicone stopper seal. Its tight seal will keep contents fresh tasting for longer.
